review_report.not_reobserved: Not observed this round; closure unverified

review_report.legacy_policy: The exact policy version was not recorded for this historical run.
review_report.code_completed: Review completed; human decision still required
review_report.code_next: Review findings and missing coverage, then make a version-bound human decision.
